response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) as cnt FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), total_and_num AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total, COUNT(*) as num_hands FROM hand_counts), hand_shares AS (SELECT hc.cnt, hc.cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_and_num) as share, 1.0 / (SELECT num_hands FROM total_and_num) as avg_share FROM hand_counts hc) SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess FROM hand_shares WHERE share > avg_share;
